_curation_note: PQSigner semantic curation: requestExit is admitted only for the fixed-block Igra KasExitBridge proxy listed by deploymentFormats. The trusted display shows the complete Kaspa payout string, exact KAS unlock amount in sompi, and exact native iKAS value. Verified source requires value = (unlock sompi + mutable fee sompi) x 10^10 wei, burns only unlock sompi x 10^10 wei, and dispatches an asynchronous Kaspa exit request; it does not burn the whole transaction value or promise completion. Evidence is historical fixed-block source/runtime authority, not live fee, throttle, amount policy, endpoint, transaction success, Kaspa payout, future proxy upgrades, fallback, or blind signing. See tests/erc7730-semantic-evidence/bridge-exits.
